name: zinput_bind_group_list_get_group_title
description: zInput::BindGroupList_GetGroupTitle returns the title pointer for the selected bind-group.
known_limits: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x42a4a0 with VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob0_facs failed: BN size 11, VC size 16, 2 unmasked byte mismatches. A profile sweep across vc5_o2_ob0_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs, vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs, vc5_o2_ob0_facs, and vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs kept the same 2-byte mismatch; normalized diff shows the compiler uses ecx for the loaded group pointer where original reuses eax.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x42a4a0 loads g_zInput_BindGroupInfoList.begin[groupIndex] and returns the first field, the group title pointer.
Native smoke verifies group index 0 returns the exact title pointer stored in the test bind-group.
